thread:
alex: FYI my feature/quantize-optimizer branch is red on linux-integration after rebasing onto main. Failing unit: tests/inference/kv_cache_test.go: TestKVCacheEviction. Anyone seen this locally?
sam: I can take a look. Which commit did you rebase onto?
alex: main@1767609876 — only conflict was proto change in kv.proto. Tests pass locally for me on mac but CI fails on linux: segfault in cgo layer.
ci-bot: Build #4821 failed: linux-integration shard - Job logs: https://ci.redwood/in/4821/logs
priya: Segfault in cgo usually ABI/GLIBC mismatch or flaky test. Can you paste the failing stack?
alex: stack trace:
```
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
goroutine 89 [running]:
redwood/inference/kv.(*Cache).Evict(0xc000016000)
	/home/runner/work/redwood/inference/kv/cache.go:132 +0x45
```
robin: Have you run with CGO_ENABLED=1 on linux and the same go version? CI uses go1.21.2
alex: Uh I was on go1.20.8 locally. Trying a local linux container now.
david: @alex re-running CI with your branch pinned to go1.21.2 to reproduce. Holding for bisect? :eyes:
sam: If it's only on linux, try `GOFLAGS=-mod=mod CGO_ENABLED=1 go test ./inference/kv -run TestKVCacheEviction -v` in ubuntu:22.04
alex: Put the command in the thread. I ran it in a docker ubuntu:22.04 and reproduced. Adding logs to gist: https://gist.github.com/xyz
priya: Looks like a nil deref at cache.go:132 — maybe proto change altered initialization order. Did the proto change add a new required field?
alex: The proto added one optional field. I initialize via proto.Unmarshal. Might be a concurrency edge.
robin: Quick workaround: flake guard the test with `t.SkipOnCI`? Not ideal. Better to bisect commit between your rebase point and main. @david can you run bisect job?
david: Starting bisect job: https://ci.redwood/in/4825/bisect — will report back.
ci-bot: Build #4825 started (bisect).
alex: Thanks all. If bisect points to main, I'll open a hotfix PR. If it's my change, I'll fix and push.
david: Bisect found culprit: 1767599999 - 'proto: change default for CacheEntry' — reverting in patch fixes tests. I'll open revert PR and add a note.
sam: Nice find. @alex adjust your rebase to include revert or update initialization.
alex: Will do, pushing a fix now. Thanks :party_parrot:
